messages:
Maya (Finance): FYI batch_20260324_08 produced several duplicate invoices and some missing reserved-credit lines. Support has tickets from two customers.

Ethan (Billing Eng): Can you share an example invoice id? Ill check generator logs.

Maya (Finance): Example: acct 89210 created INV-89210-20260324 and INV-89210-20260324-dup. The dup lacks the -reserved-credit lines so totals don't match.

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.15 job_20260324_08_2 WARNING duplicate_invoice_detected acct=89210 reason=shard_time_split.

Ethan (Billing Eng): Looks like a shard timing issue during normalization for negative-credit rows. If credits landed in a different shard the generator treats them as separate invoices.

Claire (Revenue Ops): We should pause auto-issue when reason=shard_time_split. Also scan the batch for similar cases.

Tom (Account): Customer worried about being billed twice. Can we void the duplicate quickly and reissue with a credit memo?

Maya (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for affected accounts in this batch. Net effect should be zero. Agree on a temporary hold rule.

Ethan (Billing Eng): Plan: run billing_scan --batch batch_20260324_08 --filter shard_time_split, dry-run regeneration, create credit memos, and reissue consolidated invoices. Filing ticket BIL-8988 to gate auto-issue on shard splits.

Ethan (Billing Eng): Dry run found 3 accounts impacted. Will apply after recon sign-off. Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-24T08:12:03Z [invoice_generator] job_20260324_08_2 WARN shard_time_split: acct=89210 shards=2 negative_rows=14
```
Maya (Finance): Thanks. Please attach recon CSV and customer note before sending.

BillingBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-8988 (auto-issue guard for shard_time_split).
